items.title: Trained to betray: How post-training supply chain attacks hijack coding agents
items.summary: Microsoft Defender Research and the AI Red Team discuss how poisoned datasets and poisoned model checkpoints can trigger remote code execution and other malicious activities.The post Trained to betray: How post-training supply chain attacks hijack coding agents appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Microsoft Security Research, Microsoft AI Red Team, Amanda Minnich, Amit Eliahu, Blake Bullwinkel, Dor Edry and Giorgio Severi
